content:
Ñaamooɓe bindi-ɗi (waylooɓe) ɗon e sicco ɗum ɓurnooɓe ɗiɗi... 

Actually, here is the translation:

Wanyooɓe ɓaleeji ɗon e kuutiniroo-ɗi ndaaree ɓurɗum gooŋɗum e nder gaɗa-ɗum ngam yaajnude yeeso mbaadi ruttugo ɓaleeji ɓee, ɓe ndaarirmaa ko ɓe poti haa jooɗiiɓe wuro ngam yiɗde ko heewi.

Correction, final clean version:

Ɓeydaari wanyooɓe nder ndaarirgo wonndoo ɗon hoolnoyaama ɓurɗum e ndaarooɓe ladde, ngam ndaarirɗum ɗum kawtal ɗon nder ndaarirgo e ñaawoyaago nafoore mum.
